notes: Auth: the firebase CLI login (a project owner); security rules do not apply.
Times, durations, page tokens and transaction ids are replaced by placeholders (normalise in lib.mjs); everything else is as returned.

The valid.* cases read 3000 documents written to aruma-ref-f3-part before them (bulk); they are not replayable (the partition points are production's sampling). The invalid.* cases read aruma-ref-f3-pqx, whose one document is the setup.
f0-descendants.json has the earlier partition cases (a kindless parent, a collection that is not a group, no order, a filter).

versions.api: firestore.googleapis.com REST v1 and gRPC google.firestore.v1.Firestore
